title: Micme configuration
description: Machine-level Micme settings. Shell environment variables override saved values. Invalid numeric values fall back to the documented defaults at runtime.

MICME_SHORTCUT.description: Unified toggle shortcut. Use terminal syntax such as alt+m/ctrl+space/f8, or a printable character such as §.

MICME_PRINTABLE_SHORTCUTS.description: Legacy printable-character fallback. Prefer MICME_SHORTCUT with a printable character.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_BACKEND.description: Select transcription backend. auto preserves priority: custom command, whisper.cpp, then Python Whisper.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Transcription timeout in whole milliseconds. Runtime range: 1000 through 3600000.

MICME_LANGUAGE.description: Transcription language when translation is off. Use auto for language detection.

MICME_TRANSLATE_TO_ENGLISH.description: Translate from control. off disables translation; any language code means translate speech in that source language to English.

MICME_AUTO_DOWNLOAD_MODEL.description: Download a missing standard whisper.cpp model automatically. Defaults on.

MICME_DEFAULT_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.description: whisper.cpp model name mapped to MICME_MODEL_DIR/ggml-<name>.bin unless MICME_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL is set.

MICME_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.description: Advanced whisper.cpp exact ggml/gguf model path override. When set, it wins over MICME_DEFAULT_WHISPER_CPP_MODEL.

MICME_WHISPER_CPP_BIN.description: Command or path for whisper.cpp clip transcription. Leave unset to find whisper-cli/whisper-cpp on PATH.

MICME_WHISPER_MODEL.description: Model name passed to the OpenAI Whisper Python CLI when the Python backend is used.

MICME_RECORD_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Raw recording sample-rate override in whole Hz from 8000 through 384000. Leave auto/unset so ffmpeg uses the selected input's native sample rate.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Sample rate in whole Hz from 8000 through 384000 for processed audio sent to Whisper.

MICME_RECORD_SYNC.description: Preserve wall-clock recording duration from ffmpeg timestamps with aresample async correction. Defaults on.

MICME_RECORD_METER.description: Enable the legacy ffmpeg stdout PCM branch for live metering. Defaults off to avoid recorder backpressure; the UI can still meter by polling raw.wav.

MICME_AVFOUNDATION_DROP_LATE_FRAMES.description: macOS AVFoundation only. Defaults off so ffmpeg is asked not to drop late frames when capture lags.

MICME_AVFOUNDATION_INPUT_SAMPLE_RATE.description: Advanced macOS fallback from 8000 through 384000 Hz used only when MICME_RECORD_SYNC=0.

MICME_VALIDATE_AUDIO.description: Reject near-silent clips and fail when ffmpeg does not provide complete max-volume evidence.

MICME_STREAM_CAPTURE.description: whisper-stream/SDL capture id from -1 through 255. -1 selects the system default.

MICME_STREAM_STEP_MS.description: whisper-stream processing step in whole milliseconds from 100 through 60000.

MICME_STREAM_LENGTH_MS.description: whisper-stream audio window in whole milliseconds from 1000 through 120000.

MICME_STREAM_KEEP_MS.description: whisper-stream overlap retained in whole milliseconds from 0 through 60000.

MICME_STREAM_KEEP_CONTEXT.description: Pass --keep-context to whisper-stream. Defaults to off for append-only dictation.

MICME_STREAM_FINALIZE_WITH_CLIP.description: When enabled, stop-time clip transcription may replace the append-only live stream transcript.

MICME_STREAM_FLUSH_MS.description: Quiet interval in whole milliseconds from 100 through 60000 before tentative stream words are committed append-only.

MICME_STREAM_WORDS_PER_CHUNK.description: Maximum stable words committed per streaming update, from 1 through 10.

MICME_STREAM_VAD_THRESHOLD.description: whisper-stream voice activity threshold from 0.01 through 0.99.

MICME_RECORD_COMMAND.description: Advanced shell command hook. Use only trusted commands.

MICME_TRANSCRIBE_COMMAND.description: Advanced custom transcription shell command. Use only trusted commands; Micme cannot inspect which model it uses.

^MICME_.description: Micme runtime setting. Values are read as strings by Micme.
